note_title: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#1
callouts.title: 问题0：（北师大2025夏令营）
callouts.body: Lebesgue可测函数列$||f_n||_{L^1(\mathbb{R})}\leq \frac{1}{4^n}$证明$f_n(x)$几乎处处收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#1
classification_result.english_title: Problem 0: Beijing Normal University 2025 Summer Camp

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of Lebesgue measurable functions such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^1(\mathbb{R})} \leq \frac{1}{4^n}\). Prove that \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere.

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#2
callouts.title: 想法1.2.l
callouts.body:
如果函数列$f_n(x)$构成的含参数级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}f_n(x)$是**几乎处处绝对收敛**的，那么由于绝对收敛的必要条件，$f_n(x)$就是几乎处处收敛到0。

尝试证明$\sum_{n\geq 1}f_n(x)$几乎处处绝对收敛的途径，可以从证明$\sum_{n\geq 1}|f_n(x)|$可积来证明。因为$\int_{\mathbb{R}}\sum_{n\geq 1}|f_n(x)|\,dx <\infty$，可以导出$\sum_{n\geq 1}|f_n(x)|$几乎处处有限，也就是几乎处处绝对收敛。

证明$\sum_{n\geq 1}|f_n(x)|$可积这件事，**单调收敛定理**则可以排上用场，单调收敛可以保证积分与级数可以交换次序，从而$$\int_{\mathbb{R}} \sum_{n\geq 1}|f_n(x)|\,dx = \sum_{n\geq 1}\int_{\mathbb{R}}|f_n(x)|\,dx = \sum_{n\geq 1}||f_n||_{L^1}$$由“问题0”的条件，右边的级数是收敛的，于是整个逻辑可以成立，从而函数列$f_n(x)$几乎处处收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#2

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Prove almost everywhere convergence via absolute summability
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To show \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere, prove that the series \(\sum_{n\ge 1} f_n(x)\) converges absolutely almost everywhere. A standard route is to show \(\sum_{n\ge 1} |f_n(x)|\) is integrable by exchanging sum and integral using the monotone convergence theorem.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when one has a sequence of measurable functions with summable \(L^1\) norms or other hypotheses implying integrability of \(\sum |f_n|\).

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#3
callouts.title: 引理1.2.2：单调收敛定理(Beppo-Levi定理)
callouts.body: $(\Sigma,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间，序列$\{f_n\}_{n=1}^{\infty}$是一个定义在$X\in \Sigma$上的逐点不减，非负$(\Sigma,\mathcal{B}_{\overline{\mathbb{R}}_{\geq 0}})$的可测函数列。那么这个函数列逐点的上极限，即$$\sup_{n\geq 1}f_n:x\mapsto \sup_{n\geq 1} f_n(x)$$也是一个$(\Sigma,\mathcal{B}_{\overline{\mathbb{R}}_{\geq 0}})$可测函数，并且$$\sup_{n\geq 1}\int_{X} f_n\,d\mu = \int_{X}\sup_{n\geq 1} f_n\,d\mu$$

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#3

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \((\Sigma, \mathcal{F}, \mu)\) be a measure space, and let \(\{f_n\}_{n=1}^{\infty}\) be a sequence of nonnegative measurable functions on \(X \in \Sigma\) that is pointwise nondecreasing. Then the pointwise supremum
\[
\sup_{n\geq 1} f_n : x \mapsto \sup_{n\geq 1} f_n(x)
\]
is measurable, and
\[
\sup_{n\geq 1} \int_X f_n\, d\mu = \int_X \sup_{n\geq 1} f_n\, d\mu.
\]

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#4
callouts.title: 命题2.1.1
callouts.body: Lebesgue可测函数列$||f_n||_{L^p(\mathbb{R})}^p\leq a_n$其中$p\geq 1$，并且非负序列$a_n$满足$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$收敛，那么$f_n(x)$几乎处处收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#4

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of Lebesgue measurable functions such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^p(\mathbb{R})}^p \leq a_n\), where \(p \geq 1\), and let \(\{a_n\}\) be a nonnegative sequence with \(\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n\) convergent. Then \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere.

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#5
callouts.title: 例子2.2.1
callouts.body: 参考[[打字机函数列（type writer sequence）]]，这就是一个$L^p$收敛但并非几乎处处收敛的可测函数列的例子，并且这个函数列不但不是几乎处处收敛，它在任何一个点都不收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#5

if_problem.statement_en: The typewriter sequence provides an example of a sequence of measurable functions that converges in \(L^p\) but does not converge almost everywhere; in fact, it does not converge to \(0\) at any point.
key_techniques: distinguishing \(L^p\) convergence from almost everywhere convergence

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#6
callouts.title: 命题2.3.1
callouts.body:
Lebesgue可测的函数列满足：
1. $||f_n||_{L^p(\mathbb{R})}\to 0$
2. $f_n$非负，且对于几乎所有$x$逐点单调递减

那么函数列几乎处处收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#6

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of Lebesgue measurable functions such that:
1. \(\|f_n\|_{L^p(\mathbb{R})} \to 0\);
2. \(f_n\) is nonnegative and pointwise monotone decreasing for almost every \(x\).
Then \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere.

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#7
callouts.title: 命题2.4.1
callouts.body: 设$f_n$是概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上的一个随机变量$||f_n||_{L^2}\to 0$，并且$f_n$的方差形成的级数收敛那么此随机变量几乎处处收敛到0。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#7

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of random variables on a probability space \((\Omega, \mathcal{F}, P)\) such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^2} \to 0\), and suppose the series of variances \(\sum_{n\ge 1} \mathrm{Var}(f_n)\) converges. Then \(f_n\) converges to \(0\) almost surely.

callouts.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#8
callouts.title: 例子2.4.2：打字机函数列不满足命题2.4.1的条件
callouts.body: 我们已经知道对于打字机函数列而言$f_n$对任意的$L^p$范数都是收敛到0的。此处的关键在于计算这个函数列的方差。由于$$V(f_n)=E(f^2_n)-(E(f_n))^2=\frac{1}{2^k}-\frac{1}{4^k}$$对任意的$2^k\leq n<2^{k+1}$成立。那么由于$$V(f_n)\geq \frac{1}{2^{k+1}}\geq \frac{1}{2n}$$因此$\sum_{n\geq 1}V(f_n)$不是一个收敛的级数，因此打字机数列并不满足“命题2.4.1”对方差的要求。

classification_result.id: 函数列Lp范数的怎样的衰减速度能保证函数列几乎处处收敛到0#8
classification_result.english_title: Example 2.4.2: The Typewriter Sequence Does Not Satisfy the Hypotheses of Proposition 2.4.1

if_problem.statement_en:
Although the typewriter sequence converges to \(0\) in every \(L^p\) norm, it does not satisfy the variance condition in Proposition 2.4.1. Indeed, for every \(2^k \leq n < 2^{k+1}\),
\[
\mathrm{Var}(f_n)=E(f_n^2)-(E(f_n))^2=\frac{1}{2^k}-\frac{1}{4^k},
\]
so
\[
\mathrm{Var}(f_n) \geq \frac{1}{2^{k+1}} \geq \frac{1}{2n}.
\]
Hence \(\sum_{n\geq 1} \mathrm{Var}(f_n)\) diverges, so the typewriter sequence does not satisfy the variance hypothesis of Proposition 2.4.1.
